fullText.simplified:
元少来了

    半个月以后，曹操听说刘备打败了元树。再过半个月，曹操又听说刘备带着军队回到了徐州。徐州城里的那些人，又在为刘备工作了，现在徐州又是刘备的了。
    徐州！又是徐州！
    因为徐州，爸爸死了，他用了很多时间才拿下徐州。徐州不能给别人！曹操太生气了，突然觉得头疼，人也站不住了，一下子坐到了地上……
    几天以后，曹操准备去打刘备，他要拿回徐州。
    但就在这个时候，北方的元少带着三十万人的军队往河南曹操这儿来了。
    元少在北方准备了很久，一直没有往南方来，为什么这个时候来了呢？
    其实元少是为了帮刘备。刘备回到徐州以后，知道曹操不会放过自己。助手们都说，可以给河北的元少写信，虽然刘备打败了他的弟弟元树，但是元少也很想打败曹操，对元少来说，现在的刘备是可以帮他打曹操的人，他一定愿意帮刘备。
    刘备就给元少写了信。和助手说的一样，元少同意了。现在，元少带着三十万军队往曹操这儿来了……
fullText.traditional:
元少來了

    半個月以後，曹操聽說劉備打敗了元樹。再過半個月，曹操又聽說劉備帶著軍隊回到了徐州。徐州城裡的那些人，又在為劉備工作了，現在徐州又是劉備的了。
    徐州！又是徐州！
    因為徐州，爸爸死了，他用了很多時間才拿下徐州。徐州不能給別人！曹操太生氣了，突然覺得頭疼，人也站不住了，一下子坐到了地上……
    幾天以後，曹操準備去打劉備，他要拿回徐州。
    但就在這個時候，北方的元少帶著三十萬人的軍隊往河南曹操這兒來了。
    元少在北方準備了很久，一直沒有往南方來，為什麼這個時候來了呢？
    其實元少是為了幫劉備。劉備回到徐州以後，知道曹操不會放過自己。助手們都說，可以給河北的元少寫信，雖然劉備打敗了他的弟弟元樹，但是元少也很想打敗曹操，對元少來說，現在的劉備是可以幫他打曹操的人，他一定願意幫劉備。
    劉備就給元少寫了信。和助手說的一樣，元少同意了。現在，元少帶著三十萬軍隊往曹操這兒來了……

sentences.simplified: 半个月以后，曹操听说刘备打败了元树。
sentences.traditional: 半個月以後，曹操聽說劉備打敗了元樹。
sentences.pinyin: bàn ge yuè yǐ hòu cáo cāo tīng shuō liú bèi dǎ bài le yuán shù
sentences.english: Half a month later, Cao Cao heard that Liu Bei had defeated Yuan Shu.

sentences.simplified: 再过半个月，曹操又听说刘备带着军队回到了徐州。
sentences.traditional: 再過半個月，曹操又聽說劉備帶著軍隊回到了徐州。
sentences.pinyin: zài guò bàn ge yuè cáo cāo yòu tīng shuō liú bèi dài zhe jūn duì huí dào le xú zhōu
sentences.english: After another half month, Cao Cao again heard that Liu Bei had returned to Xuzhou with his troops.

sentences.simplified: 徐州城里的那些人，又在为刘备工作了，现在徐州又是刘备的了。
sentences.traditional: 徐州城裡的那些人，又在為劉備工作了，現在徐州又是劉備的了。
sentences.pinyin: xú zhōu chéng lǐ de nà xiē rén yòu zài wèi liú bèi gōng zuò le xiàn zài xú zhōu yòu shì liú bèi de le
sentences.english: The people in the city of Xuzhou were working for Liu Bei once more. Xuzhou was now Liu Bei’s once more.

sentences.simplified: 徐州！又是徐州！
sentences.traditional: 徐州！又是徐州！
sentences.pinyin: xú zhōu yòu shì xú zhōu

sentences.simplified: 因为徐州，爸爸死了，他用了很多时间才拿下徐州。
sentences.traditional: 因為徐州，爸爸死了，他用了很多時間才拿下徐州。
sentences.pinyin: yīn wèi xú zhōu bà ba sǐ le tā yòng le hěn duō shí jiān cái ná xià xú zhōu
sentences.english: Because of Xuzhou, his father had died. It had taken him a long time to capture Xuzhou.

sentences.simplified: 徐州不能给别人！曹操太生气了，
sentences.traditional: 徐州不能給別人！曹操太生氣了，
sentences.pinyin: xú zhōu bù néng gěi bié ren cáo cāo tài shēng qì le
sentences.english: Xuzhou must not be given to anyone else! Cao Cao was very angry.

sentences.simplified: 突然觉得头疼，人也站不住了，一下子坐到了地上……
sentences.traditional: 突然覺得頭疼，人也站不住了，一下子坐到了地上……
sentences.pinyin: tū rán jué de tóu téng rén yě zhàn bu zhù le yí xià zi zuò dào le dì shang
sentences.english: He suddenly felt a headache. He couldn’t stand up and suddenly sat down on the ground …

sentences.simplified: 几天以后，曹操准备去打刘备，他要拿回徐州。
sentences.traditional: 幾天以後，曹操準備去打劉備，他要拿回徐州。
sentences.pinyin: jǐ tiān yǐ hòu cáo cāo zhǔn bèi qù dǎ liú bèi tā yào ná huí xú zhōu
sentences.english: A few days later, Cao Cao was ready to fight Liu Bei. He wanted to take back Xuzhou.

sentences.simplified: 但就在这个时候，北方的元少带着三十万人的军队往河南曹操这儿来了。
sentences.traditional: 但就在這個時候，北方的元少帶著三十萬人的軍隊往河南曹操這兒來了。
sentences.pinyin: dàn jiù zài zhè ge shí hou běi fāng de yuán shào dài zhe sān shí wàn rén de jūn duì wǎng hé nán cáo cāo zhè‘r lái le
sentences.english: But just at this moment, Yuan Shao in the north came with 300,000 troops towards Cao Cao here in Henan.

sentences.simplified: 元少在北方准备了很久，一直没有往南方来，
sentences.traditional: 元少在北方準備了很久，一直沒有往南方來，
sentences.pinyin: yuán shào zài běi fāng zhǔn bèi le hěn jiǔ yì zhí méi yǒu wǎng nán fāng lái
sentences.english: Yuan Shao had been preparing for a long time in the north and had never come to the south before.

sentences.simplified: 为什么这个时候来了呢？
sentences.traditional: 為什麼這個時候來了呢？
sentences.pinyin: wèi shén me zhè ge shí hou lái le ne
sentences.english: So why did he come this time?

sentences.simplified: 其实元少是为了帮刘备。刘备回到徐州以后，知道曹操不会放过自己。
sentences.traditional: 其實元少是為了幫劉備。劉備回到徐州以後，知道曹操不會放過自己。
sentences.pinyin: qí shí yuán shào shì wèi le bāng liú bèi liú bèi huí dào xú zhōu yǐ hòu zhī dào cáo cāo bú huì fàng guò zì jǐ
sentences.english: Actually, Yuan Shao was helping Liu Bei. After Liu Bei returned to Xuzhou, he knew that Cao Cao would not spare him.

sentences.simplified: 助手们都说，可以给河北的元少写信，
sentences.traditional: 助手們都說，可以給河北的元少寫信，
sentences.pinyin: zhù shǒu men dōu shuō kě yǐ gěi hé běi de yuán shào xiě xìn
sentences.english: The assistants all said that he could write to Yuan Shao in Hebei.

sentences.simplified: 虽然刘备打败了他的弟弟元树，但是元少也很想打败曹操，
sentences.traditional: 雖然劉備打敗了他的弟弟元樹，但是元少也很想打敗曹操，
sentences.pinyin: suī rán liú bèi dǎ bài le tā de dì di yuán shù dàn shì yuán shào yě hěn xiǎng dǎ bài cáo cāo
sentences.english: Although Liu Bei had defeated his younger brother Yuan Shu, Yuan Shao also wanted to defeat Cao Cao.

sentences.simplified: 对元少来说，现在的刘备是可以帮他打曹操的人，他一定愿意帮刘备。
sentences.traditional: 對元少來說，現在的劉備是可以幫他打曹操的人，他一定願意幫劉備。
sentences.pinyin: duì yuán shào lái shuō xiàn zài de liú bèi shì kě yǐ bāng tā dǎ cáo cāo de rén tā yí dìng yuàn yì bāng liú bèi
sentences.english: For Yuan Shao, Liu Bei was now the man who could help him fight Cao Cao. He would definitely be willing to help Liu Bei.

sentences.simplified: 刘备就给元少写了信。和助手说的一样，元少同意了。
sentences.traditional: 劉備就給元少寫了信。和助手說的一樣，元少同意了。
sentences.pinyin: liú bèi jiù gěi yuán shào xiě le xìn hé zhù shǒu shuō de yí yàng yuán shào tóng yì le
sentences.english: So, Liu Bei wrote a letter to Yuan Shao. Just as the assistants had said, Yuan Shao agreed.

sentences.simplified: 现在，元少带着三十万军队往曹操这儿来了……
sentences.traditional: 現在，元少帶著三十萬軍隊往曹操這兒來了……
sentences.pinyin: xiàn zài yuán shào dài zhe sān shí wàn jūn duì wǎng cáo cāo zhè‘r lái le
sentences.english: Now, Yuan Shao was heading towards Cao Cao with 300,000 troops …

sentence_translations: Half a month later, Cao Cao heard that Liu Bei had defeated Yuan Shu.
After another half month, Cao Cao again heard that Liu Bei had returned to Xuzhou with his troops.
The people in the city of Xuzhou were working for Liu Bei once more. Xuzhou was now Liu Bei’s once more.
Because of Xuzhou, his father had died. It had taken him a long time to capture Xuzhou.
Xuzhou must not be given to anyone else! Cao Cao was very angry.
He suddenly felt a headache. He couldn’t stand up and suddenly sat down on the ground …
A few days later, Cao Cao was ready to fight Liu Bei. He wanted to take back Xuzhou.
But just at this moment, Yuan Shao in the north came with 300,000 troops towards Cao Cao here in Henan.
Yuan Shao had been preparing for a long time in the north and had never come to the south before.
So why did he come this time?
Actually, Yuan Shao was helping Liu Bei. After Liu Bei returned to Xuzhou, he knew that Cao Cao would not spare him.
The assistants all said that he could write to Yuan Shao in Hebei.
Although Liu Bei had defeated his younger brother Yuan Shu, Yuan Shao also wanted to defeat Cao Cao.
For Yuan Shao, Liu Bei was now the man who could help him fight Cao Cao. He would definitely be willing to help Liu Bei.
So, Liu Bei wrote a letter to Yuan Shao. Just as the assistants had said, Yuan Shao agreed.
Now, Yuan Shao was heading towards Cao Cao with 300,000 troops …
